This '''unidentified droid commando''' was a [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]] that was assigned to a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] prison named the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] during a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] attack to free [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]]. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] managed to escape with the help of a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] led by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], this [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and a number of other [[Commando/Legends|commando]] droids accompanied the [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]] to the dungeon where Piell's naval fleet officers and their captain, [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] had been held. The commando reported to Sobeck that Piell and Piell's [[Officer/Legends|officers]] had escaped, and the angered Phindian responded by ordering [[Unidentified BX-series droid commando captain (Citadel)/Legends|another BX-series commando]] to execute the droid.<ref name="citadel" />
